issuing_department.description: The municipal department that issued the standard details, as printed in the title block, e.g. 'City of Albany - Department of Engineering'

city_engineer.description: The name of the City Engineer printed beneath the city logo in the title block, including any professional credential, e.g. 'P.E.'

sheets.description: One entry per sheet in the set, in page order, read from each sheet's title block

detail_number.description: The detail number from the DETAIL No. box, e.g. 'C-1'

detail_name.description: The detail name from the DETAIL NAME box, as a single line

file_name.description: The CAD file name from the FILE NAME box, including the extension, e.g. 'C-1.DWG'

revision_date.description: The date from the REVISION DATE box, as YYYY-MM-DD

drop_curb.description: Specifications from the Driveway/Sidewalk Drop Curb detail, sheet DW-1

max_gradient.description: The maximum gradient of the drop, as a ratio, from the MAX. GRADIENT callout, e.g. '1:12'

max_cross_slope.description: The maximum cross-slope that applies within the walking path, as a ratio, from the same callout as the gradient

transition_length.description: The length of each sloped transition either side of the driveway, from the dimension string, in feet and inches as printed, e.g. 6'-0"

driveway_width.description: The driveway width requirement from the dimension string between the two transitions

concrete_thickness.description: The concrete thickness from the concrete callout, in inches as printed

concrete_reference_detail.description: The detail number the concrete callout refers to for its specification

curb_material.description: The curbing material named in the callout at the edge of the sidewalk

surface_finish.description: The surface finish named in the callouts on the concrete panels

max_curb_reveal.description: The maximum curb reveal where the ramp meets the roadway pavement, from the notes, in inches as printed

notes.description: Each numbered note on the sheet, in order

items.description: The note text, without its number
